package v1

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

// NewRouter registers public API routes.
func NewRouter(courseHandler *handlers.CourseHandler, trackHandler *handlers.TrackHandler, levelHandler *handlers.CourseLevelHandler, groupHandler *handlers.CourseGroupHandler, moduleHandler *handlers.ModuleHandler, sectionHandler *handlers.SectionHandler, lessonHandler *handlers.LessonHandler, lessonRelationsHandler *handlers.LessonRelationsHandler, lessonExamplesHandler *handlers.LessonExamplesHandler, exampleRelationsHandler *handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler, taskHandler *handlers.TaskHandler, positionHandler *handlers.PositionHandler) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Get("/catalog/scope/list", courseHandler.ListCatalogScopes)
	r.Get("/catalog/course/list", courseHandler.ListCatalog)
	r.Get("/course/list", courseHandler.List)
	r.Get("/course/get/{courseID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", courseHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/course/get-by-slug/{slug}", courseHandler.GetBySlug)
	r.Get("/course/{courseID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}/outline", courseHandler.Outline)
	r.Get("/track/list", trackHandler.List)
	r.Get("/track/get/{trackID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", trackHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/level/list", levelHandler.List)
	r.Get("/level/get/{levelID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", levelHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/course-group/list", groupHandler.List)
	r.Get("/course-group/get/{groupID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", groupHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/module/list", moduleHandler.List)
	r.Get("/section/list", sectionHandler.List)
	r.Get("/lesson/list", lessonHandler.List)
	r.Get("/lesson/get/{lessonID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", lessonHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/lesson-materials/get/{lessonID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", lessonHandler.Materials)
	r.Get("/lesson-relations/list/{sourceLessonID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", lessonRelationsHandler.List)
	r.Get("/lesson-examples/list/{lessonID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", lessonExamplesHandler.ListPublic)
	r.Get("/example-relations/list/{sourceExampleID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", exampleRelationsHandler.ListPublic)
	r.Get("/task/list", taskHandler.List)
	r.Get("/task/get/{taskID:[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}}", taskHandler.Get)
	r.Get("/position/list", positionHandler.List)
	r.Get("/position/get/{positionID}", positionHandler.Get)
	return r
}
